title: Grateful Dead Live at Avalon Ballroom on 1968-10-12
source: Recording Info: SBD -> ?? -> cdr -> wav via EAC -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Excellent broadcast-quality recording of a great show highlighted by a standout Morning Dew with Jerry’s rare falsetto.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the performance, calling it a must‑have and praising the faithful broadcast sound that matches their old tapes. The main highlight is the opening of side two with a powerful Morning Dew where Jerry adds a little falsetto, and the overall vibe is very positive.

ai_rating.rationale: Two consistent 5‑star reviews emphasize both superb show energy and high‑quality broadcast recording; limited number of reviews keeps confidence at medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note the tape matches the broadcast’s speed, crowd ambience and clarity – no complaints about muddiness or drop‑outs.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on overall set flow; focus is on the opening Morning Dew which sets a strong tone.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Adds a little falsetto toward the end of Morning Dew, noted as a special moment.
